---
title: A letter
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    type: letter
    letter-standard: iso
format: mcanouil-typst
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: An unknown letter standard stops the render with the values to use.
        errors: strict
    mcanouil-typst:
      shouldError: true
      printsMessage:
        level: ERROR
        regex: 'mcanouil: unknown letter-standard "iso"; use din, nf\.'
---

A paragraph.
